privileged_info_for_vlm: The resource plan must be named 'STABILITY_PLAN'. Consumer groups are 'CRITICAL_APP_CG' and 'BATCH_REPORT_CG'. CPU allocations at Management Level 1 must be: CRITICAL_APP_CG=60%, BATCH_REPORT_CG=20%, OTHER_GROUPS=20%. CRITICAL_APP_CG must have a switch rule to BATCH_REPORT_CG after 60 seconds. APP_USER maps to CRITICAL_APP_CG and RPT_USER maps to BATCH_REPORT_CG. The plan must be set to active.
